mechanism: The Deployment payments/checkout-worker has an empty environment in its pod template — spec.template.spec.containers[worker].env is absent — while the container's command requires AMQP_URL to be non-empty, so the worker container prints "FATAL: AMQP_URL not set" and exits with code 1 on every start; the kubelet restarts it repeatedly (5 restarts, waiting=CrashLoopBackOff) and the Deployment reports 0/1 Ready.
